text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Premium photorealistic wardrobe catalog asset. Portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric and metal texture, subtle contact shadows, whole object uncropped with generous margin. No captions, price labels, watermarks, surroundings or people. Single accessory only: One matching pair of black leather gloves, all fingers intact, lying neatly together. Isolated product photo, object itself centered and filling most of image. Entire straps/chains/clasp visible with wide margin. No outfit, garments, human body, display bust, mannequin, hand or prop.
